name: East Coast
summary: Park connector living, sea breeze, and a slower weekend tempo east of town.
body: East Coast (Marine Parade, Siglap, Frankel) rewards people who want outdoor space and a neighbourhood feel. East Coast Park is the weekend engine — cycling, hawker breakfasts, beach sports. Commutes into CBD are longer than Holland V or River Valley, but the lifestyle trade is deliberate. Housing spans HDB-adjacent pockets (for eligible tenants), older condos, and landed streets inland from the park.
housingMix: Condos facing the park, landed inland, some HDB for eligible renters.
commuteNotes: East Coast Line (Marine Parade, Marine Terrace); expressways to CBD.
